caveats: Google Maps was read in its limited (no-JavaScript map) view, which shows a rating when there is one but usually not the review count, and shows no rating for listings with no reviews.

Phone-width verdicts come from Chrome device emulation at 390 px; screenshots were captured for Alpha, CAM, Constellaze, AMBNJ, DeCicco and Entrustech, and the other sites were judged from measured layout width plus rendered text.
Agent-readiness scores reflect what a crawler or assistant sees today; they say nothing about traffic, reputation or service quality.
data_gaps: Aesculapius: the browser refused http (blocked by client) and https (certificate-name privacy error), so the site could not be visually inspected or screenshotted; its review rests on fetched HTML, and its phone-width verdict is an inference from the responsive Astra theme.
No business in this batch exposes its review count in the Maps limited view; recorded ratings are as displayed, and 'no rating' means none was displayed.

CRDS: no Google Business Profile was found under the company name or the East Brunswick address, and the site's contact page lists Philadelphia and Wilmington instead - the batch address may be out of date.
Constellaze's 'Touchbase' page showed only a 'Thanks for submitting!' success message when fetched, so it is unclear whether a form is present but failed to render or was removed.
No contact, quote or booking form was submitted anywhere (read-only rule), so form reliability beyond visible labelling and structure is unverified.
